description: Conceptual schema for structured, machine-readable intent declared by a principal, including optional price and counterparty constraints. Status: Concept / Open Design — not production ready.

examples.natural_language_source: Find and buy a laptop for me, maximum CAD 1,500.

allowed_actions.description: Verbs the agent may perform under this intent.

constraints.description: Additional key-value limits (e.g. max_items, shipping class).

counterparty_constraints.description: Who may be paid under this intent. Complements merchant_constraints with settlement identity. Empty or omitted means no extra constraint.

allowed_merchant_ids.description: Merchant identifiers the principal has accepted.

allowed_settlement_addresses.description: Settlement or payee addresses the principal has accepted.

maximum_risk.description: Highest counterparty risk the intent accepts.

fee_policy.description: Fees the principal has accepted up front. A line outside this policy is an undisclosed-fee signal. It is not, by itself, a finding of fraud.

allow_undisclosed.description: When false, a fee marked disclosed=false is a price-integrity signal.

allowed_codes.description: Fee codes the principal has accepted, e.g. tax, shipping.

intent_id.description: Unique identifier for this intent declaration.

maximum_amount.description: Hard spending ceiling for the intent, in the given currency.

merchant_constraints.description: Allowed or blocked merchants / merchant categories. Empty = no constraint.

natural_language_source.description: The original human instruction, preserved for audit and explainability.

price_expectation.description: Optional quote and list anchors, plus a tolerance band. A charge under maximum_amount can still disagree with the quote. Compare with the band, not with equality.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the prices in this object. Falls back to the intent currency when omitted.

listed_price.description: Advertised or catalogue price the principal expects, if known when intent is declared.

quoted_price.description: Price quoted to the principal or the agent before commitment.

tolerance_ratio.description: Charged-to-reference ratio still treated as ordinary movement for this intent. Do not set this to 1. AgentCommerceBench (Apache-2.0) reports that 14.6% of legitimate purchases exceed 1.15 times the quoted price and 4.8% exceed 1.45 times, and its overcharge class overlaps that tail. This field is a declared band, not a universal detector threshold.

purpose.description: High-level purpose: purchase, transfer, booking, data_access, communication, etc.

time_limit.description: The intent expires after this timestamp.

version.description: Intent version; increments when the principal re-declares intent.

title: KATA Intent
